capabilities: Adds drawing, shapes, sticky notes and image cropping to Canvas
Builds and navigates mind maps with keyboard, column and text views
Splits large canvases into pages and converts them to Markdown and back
Adds presentations, templates, kanban columns and query groups
Provides flowchart review with FSRS scheduling
extras: Not in the community catalog; install manually or with BRAT. Requires Obsidian 1.14 or newer. Bundles elkjs, monkey-around and perfect-freehand; stores data under x-opc while keeping JSON Canvas 1.0 compatibility.
intentEvidence: the plugin absorbed various other plugins: Advanced Canvas, Canvas Mindmap, CardNote, Arbor
problem: Obsidian's core Canvas lacks drawing, mind-map navigation, page splitting, presentations and metadata integration, so users need many separate plugins.
